A '''garrison''' was associated with a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pekt's clan|clan]], of which [[Pekt]] was a member. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] contained [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]-of-war who had been captured as part of the longstanding rivalry between the two [[Species/Legends|species]]. As Pekt entered his molt stage of development, he moved on from experimenting on his families' servants to using the Wookiees kept in the garrison as test subjects. Pekt realized that Wookiees would make excellent [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] if they could be tamed, causing him to develop a series of restraints and techniques with which to hold them.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pekt's clan's garrison was mentioned in Pekt's DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
